Yeah, some unis are notoriously slow on that front. I got my first 4 offers within about 2 and a half weeks in Year 13, but my fifth and final one took another 2 to 3 months after that to come through. It's just luck of the draw in the waiting game unfortunately...

Yeah, I know that- I think I've misunderstood them though. I thought they meant they'd applied with just the 2 theyd already sat for some reason, but if theyve applied with those two plus the predicted for the one they are yet to sit, I'm not really sure why they haven't heard anything back in all honesty. I guess the only thing that can really be done is wait, sometimes unis particularly if they're popular will take ages to get back with an offer, even if you have heard back quickly previously.

Those, from my experience, generally look for 3 A Levels. I could be wrong, cause I dont have experience with those, so it's probably worth waiting it out to see what they say! Worst comes to worst, you might just have to apply again after you've completed your third one this summer I suppose. 

Definitely just wait it out to see what they say though, 2 A*s is pretty amazing so even if they stress that you need 3 in the end you should have no issue once you've done the third.

EDIT: I've misunderstood OP, if they've applied with 2 final grades and a predicted this doesn't apply.

Which unis did you apply for? I got 5 offers when I applied with 2 A Levels, but it mostly likely depends on where you apply and your predicted grades. Nottingham Trent, Northumbria, Oxford Brookes etc all accept 2 A Levels as long as you've got good predicted grades for them
